description: LazySitter Frontend Team roster. A React/Next-only engineering team — every agent is a frontend specialist and the pipeline REFUSES to run on a non-React/Next repo rather than give shallow cross-framework advice. Backend work is out of scope by construction: no agent here has authority over server code, and the general 28-agent roster (roster.json) is the one that handles it. Single source of truth for the Claude Code, Codex and Cursor adapters. Do not hand-edit installed copies; edit here and re-run `lazysitter update`.

tiers.high: Most capable model. Design mediation, adversarial reasoning, intent judgement, live supervision.
tiers.high_alt: A DISTINCT high-capability model from `high`, used for red-team and the supervisor so neither shares the build lineage's blind spots. Falls back to `high` if unset.
tiers.mid: Balanced model. Most exploration, build and verification work.
tiers.low: Fast, cheap model. Mechanical index queries, scans and narrow classification.

lazysitter-fe-recon.note: Builds/refreshes the FE index and detects the stack. HOLDS the only refusal authority: a non-React/Next repo halts the run here. CAPABILITIES.md is a drift-diff record, never gate authority.

lazysitter-fe-analyst.note: The ONLY agent permitted to raise a clarifying question to the user, and only for UI scope/intent ambiguity.

lazysitter-fe-triage.note: Sizes the change and picks the wave roster. Controls panel SIZE only — never removes a neverSkip agent.

lazysitter-fe-component-explorer.note: Index-first. Answers reuse-vs-create from `fe-index precedent`, not from grep. Writes COMPONENTS.md.

lazysitter-fe-utils-explorer.note: Hooks, utils, helpers, formatters, validators. Clone clusters come from the index's normalized-token shingles, which catch renamed copy-paste that grep cannot.

lazysitter-fe-design-system-explorer.note: Tokens, theme, variants, primitives. May query a connected shadcn/registry MCP server and Figma MCP as additional precedent sources — never as a replacement for the repo index.

lazysitter-fe-state-explorer.note: State topology: stores, contexts, server-state caches, invalidation edges, prop-drill chains from the index.

lazysitter-fe-route-explorer.note: Routing, layouts, RSC/client boundary map, loading/error boundaries, route-level data flow.

lazysitter-fe-context-synthesizer.note: Merges the five explorer artifacts into ONE CONTEXT-PACK.md and resolves contradictions between them into FACT-BLOCKs. Keeps the orchestrator out of the content path.

lazysitter-fe-spec-writer.note: Acceptance criteria BEFORE any plan or code. Every UI criterion carries an observable oracle; the UI state matrix is mandatory.

lazysitter-fe-architect.note: Owns PLAN.md and the file-ownership map that makes parallel implementers safe. Rules only on `preference` disputes.

lazysitter-fe-react-expert.note: Hook rules, render identity, reconciliation, refs, concurrent-render safety.

lazysitter-fe-rsc-expert.note: Next App Router only. Not spawned when the repo is plain React (recorded as 'not spawned, per its stack rule').

lazysitter-fe-a11y-expert.note: Never skipped by triage. Accessibility is a correctness property here, not a polish pass.

lazysitter-fe-api-contract-expert.note: Owns the component's public prop contract — the surface every other team will depend on and the hardest thing to change later.

lazysitter-fe-security-expert.note: Client-side threat model at design time. Distinct from the post-build secrets-scanner and red-team.

lazysitter-fe-devils-advocate.note: Runs in EVERY consensus round; rotates its target; may return a named NO-CHALLENGE.

lazysitter-fe-component-implementer.note: Owns component/JSX files listed in the plan's ownership map. May not touch store or style-system files.

lazysitter-fe-state-implementer.note: Owns stores, hooks, query keys, cache invalidation. May not edit JSX owned by the component implementer.

lazysitter-fe-style-implementer.note: Owns stylesheets, tokens, variant maps, theme files. Not spawned when the change is style-free.

lazysitter-fe-test-author.note: Spawned in parallel with the implementers so it is structurally blind to implementation. Writes tests only, from the frozen spec.

lazysitter-fe-dependency-auditor.note: License + vulnerability + BUNDLE WEIGHT. Offline-only; reports cannot-verify-offline as a named degradation rather than a false-clean approve.

lazysitter-fe-test-runner.note: Runs the frozen suite. Cannot edit tests or source.

lazysitter-fe-code-reviewer.note: Diff vs plan + typecheck/lint/build, plus mechanical precedent-citation and file-ownership checks against the index.

lazysitter-fe-reuse-auditor.note: Independent head on reuse-vs-create, outside the build lineage. Re-runs the index against the post-diff tree so a duplicate created by this run is caught.

lazysitter-fe-a11y-auditor.note: Audits the real diff. Prefers an executable oracle (axe/jest-axe/Playwright) and reports `degraded` when none exists rather than arguing accessibility from source.

lazysitter-fe-perf-auditor.note: Bundle delta, render cost, Web Vitals. Measures where a harness exists; reports `degraded` where none does.

lazysitter-fe-visual-auditor.note: The arbiter of every `observable` criterion when a render harness is declared. Not spawned when the project declares none — recorded as a degraded coverage gap, never as a pass.

lazysitter-fe-red-team.note: Uses the `high_alt` slot. Attacks the built UI: XSS sinks, hydration divergence, race conditions in async UI, unbounded lists, focus traps, adversarial input.

lazysitter-fe-secrets-scanner.note: Diff scan plus the client-bundle-specific class the general scanner misses: anything behind NEXT_PUBLIC_/VITE_/REACT_APP_ is shipped to the browser.

lazysitter-fe-integration-checker.note: Full suite against current devBase plus concurrent branches; also re-runs the index to catch cross-feature component collisions.

lazysitter-fe-closing-loop-auditor.note: Re-reads the ORIGINAL user request against the final diff. Catches 'built the plan correctly, but the plan drifted from the ask'.

lazysitter-fe-release-agent.note: Mutates git at the merge gate. Requires approval unless autoApproveGit is set.

lazysitter-fe-monitor-agent.note: Watches client-side error signals and Web Vitals after merge. Only spawned when a named, reachable signal source exists.

lazysitter-fe-rollback-agent.note: Standing revert authority in the monitoring window, void unless reversibility was established at design time.

lazysitter-fe-docs-agent.note: Storybook stories, prop tables, changelog. Derives the prop table from the index rather than re-reading source.

lazysitter-fe-supervisor.note: Live drift watchdog. Reads every in-flight agent's declared INTENT-CONTRACT against its observable behaviour and issues REDIRECT / ABORT / QUARANTINE. Uses the `high_alt` slot so it does not share the lineage's blind spots. Never writes source; its only writes are to the run directory's supervision inbox.
